question: A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between A and R, when counted from the right of A. Only two people sit between R and D. Only three people sit between A and B. C sits to the immediate left of Q. Who sits third to the left of S?
solution:
Given:A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

 
• Only two people sit between A and R, when counted from the right of A.
 
• Only two people sit between R and D.
 
• Only three people sit between A and B.
 
• C sits to the immediate left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78679e8df660d72c6c4e75f9b28ff36923a31ccb553775d37c85b6ec19b60838.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
